notes: File contains two standalone procedures with no package declaration: Diag and Accumulate_One_Member.
Diag (lines 1-5) is pure debug output via DBMS_OUTPUT; excluded as infrastructure.

Accumulate_One_Member is a truncated version of the full procedure — the cursor processing loops (dues accumulation, prior services, old preservations) are absent from this file. Only the initial eligibility checks (scheme check and dues retrieval) are present.
The vStDteFound flag initialisation on lines 105-108 is infrastructure setup for the cursor loop (absent in this truncated version); excluded.
The crBirthDate OPEN/FETCH/CLOSE on lines 114-116 retrieves a value only consumed by the absent cursor loop body; excluded as infrastructure setup for missing logic.

business_rules.label: CSS Scheme Eligibility
business_rules.description: Only members belonging to the CSS (Commonwealth Superannuation Scheme) are processed. If the membership's scheme short name is not 'CSS', the procedure returns immediately without accumulating days.

right_operand.label: CSS Scheme Code
right_operand.description: Hard-coded scheme identifier for the Commonwealth Superannuation Scheme

then_branch.description: Return without accumulating days — membership is not CSS

business_rules.label: Dues Retrieval Strategy
business_rules.description: Determines whether the CSS dues strip is retrieved from the cache or fetched from the database. If Calcs_Load.gCSSDuesID is null (first call for this batch), SAS_Membership_Dues.Get_Dues is called to fetch the dues ID and populate vStatus. If gCSSDuesID is already set (cache hit), it is used directly and vStatus is set to 'Y' without a database call.

branches.label: No cached dues ID — fetch from SAS_Membership_Dues

rule_set.description: Retrieve CSS dues strip ID and status for the membership; populates vDuesID and vStatus

branches.label: Cached dues ID available — use directly

rule_set.description: Set vDuesID from the cached Calcs_Load.gCSSDuesID value — no database call required
Set vStatus to 'Y' — cache path always indicates dues are available

value.label: Success Status Code
value.description: Status code indicating dues history is available

business_rules.label: Dues History Existence Check
business_rules.description: After the dues retrieval (cache or fetch), if vStatus is 'N' the membership has no dues history and processing is aborted. Only reachable when Get_Dues was called (cache-miss path) and returned status 'N'.

right_operand.label: Failure Status Code
right_operand.description: Status code indicating dues history was not found

then_branch.description: Return pStatus='N' — no dues history available for this membership
